destination.title: Axion gauge structure, symmetry protection and phenomenology
destination.question: How do gauge structure, symmetry, ultraviolet realization and cosmological setting constrain axion interactions, spectra and physical effects?
destination.summary: A proposed navigation family connecting distinct questions about axions. Its numerical provenance does not establish shared premises, universal coupling bounds or a common quantum-gravity mechanism.

systems: Axion gauge theories and ordinary local QFT
Gravitational topology and wormhole effective theories
targets: Coupling quantization, amplitudes and model-dependent parameter regions
Shift-symmetry breaking, potentials and axion quality
Field ranges, spectra, defects and observational signals
regimes: Source-specific dimensions, compactifications and symmetry phases
Perturbative model calculations where explicitly assumed
Cosmological production and post-inflationary scenarios as distinct branches
assumptions: No quantum-gravity conjecture is imposed across the family
Different gravitational mechanisms and matter phases retain their separate premises
conventions: Distinguish quantized UV coefficients from low-energy photon couplings
Distinguish coupling bounds from coupling-to-mass bounds
Preserve each source's field, charge and anomaly normalization
includes: Boundary and outside-probe sources when their descriptions support a relevant question
excludes: Treating numerical membership as scientific equivalence
A universal photon-coupling bound or universal symmetry-breaking conclusion
Identifying topology sums with α-parameter ensembles without comparing assumptions

sources.title: Couplings between QCD axion and photon from string compactification

evidence.text: What axion–photon coupling region follows from string-derived σMSSM models when PQ symmetry descends from an anomalous gauge U(1), and how does that restriction differ for approximate PQ symmetry?

sources.title: Axion Periodicity and Coupling Quantization in the Presence of Mixing

evidence.text: Can mixing and decoupling turn periodic UV axions into noncompact IR scalars, relaxing coupling quantization or enlarging field ranges? Which apparent violations survive gauge invariance, anomaly cancellation and a careful definition of the low-energy field space?

sources.title: Electromagnetic Couplings of Axions

evidence.text: Must the dominant axion–photon interaction be quantized in units proportional to e²? The paper reexamines this argument, the relation between monopoles and axion mass, and experimental signatures of more general electromagnetic axion couplings.

sources.title: Coupling a Cosmic String to a TQFT

evidence.text: How can coupling axion-Maxwell theory to a Z_n TQFT change universal string-worldsheet physics, local and extended operator spectra, and possible cosmological signals while admitting ordinary local-QFT UV completions?

sources.title: TASI Lectures: (No) Global Symmetries to Axion Physics

evidence.text: How do the global structure of gauge groups, quantization laws, anomalies and the expected absence of global symmetries in quantum gravity inform axion physics, especially the Strong CP solution and its quality problem?

sources.title: Axion domain walls, small instantons, and non-invertible symmetry breaking

evidence.text: How does the global form of a gauge group constrain axion couplings and domain walls, and when can ultraviolet small instantons break non-invertible shift symmetries sufficiently to remove vacuum degeneracy?

sources.title: F-theory Axiverse

evidence.text: What spectra and gauge couplings arise for C4 axions in F-theory compactifications with thousands of axions, and can axion-photon experiments constrain the resulting models?

sources.title: Three-form gauging of axion symmetries and gravity

evidence.text: How can nonlinearly realized anomalous Abelian symmetries be reformulated through three-form gauging, and what additional physics can undo axionic screening of strong CP, particularly through gravity?

sources.title: Couplings between QCD axion and photon from string compactification

evidence.text: Electroweak gauge-field rotation and generator traces determine the photon anomaly coefficient. With the stated representation conditions, sin²θW = Tr(T3²)/Tr(Qem²), while the color-normalized coefficient is c0aγγ = Tr(Qem²)/Tr(F3²).

sources.title: Axion Periodicity and Coupling Quantization in the Presence of Mixing

evidence.text: Integrate out heavy fields through their equations of motion and a derivative expansion; compare with mixing insertions in Feynman diagrams. Use anomalous fermion redefinitions or triangle amplitudes to identify invariant quantized couplings.

sources.title: Electromagnetic Couplings of Axions

evidence.text: Vary the two-potential action to obtain integral Maxwell equations, then differential equations away from charged worldlines. Linearize in axion couplings for laboratory predictions; solve a long-solenoid example with Bessel functions and expand at small ωaR.

sources.title: Coupling a Cosmic String to a TQFT

evidence.text: Anomaly descent and inflow are applied to a string regularized by a radial bump function: 1+ρ vanishes at the core and ρ vanishes outside it. This converts the worldsheet matching problem to consistent gauge anomalies; allowed local counterterms implement reduction of discrete anomaly coefficients modulo n.

sources.title: TASI Lectures: (No) Global Symmetries to Axion Physics

evidence.text: Reviews anomaly calculations through particle production and Landau levels, triangle diagrams and Fujikawa’s regulated measure. An anomalous quark rephasing transfers the axion–gluon coupling into the quark mass matrix for matching to the chiral Lagrangian.

sources.title: Axion domain walls, small instantons, and non-invertible symmetry breaking

evidence.text: Use magnetic line operators and discrete flux ω∈H²(M,Zp) to determine fractional instanton numbers through the Pontryagin square. Enforce invariance under the axion's full period for every allowed bundle to obtain coupling selection rules.

sources.title: Strong-$CP$ with and without gravity

evidence.text: Does coupling QCD to gravity turn strong CP from a naturalness puzzle into a consistency condition requiring an exact axion mechanism, and can a gauge formulation protect that mechanism without a global Peccei–Quinn symmetry?

sources.title: High-quality axions from higher-form symmetries in extra dimensions

evidence.text: Which generalized symmetry protects a five-dimensional Wilson-line axion, which modifications generate its potential or remove the physical axion, and what do monopoles and conjectural gravitational constraints imply for axion quality?

sources.title: Axion-gauge coupling quantization with a twist

evidence.text: How does the global Standard Model gauge group correlate the quantized axion-photon and axion-gluon couplings, and what experimental target follows when both the gauge group and gluon coupling are minimal?

sources.title: Non-standard axion electrodynamics and the dual Witten effect

evidence.text: Can electromagnetic duality consistently produce non-standard axion-photon couplings, including inverse-electric-coupling enhancement and effective magnetic currents, while retaining a light axion and Standard Model phenomenology?

sources.title: Higher-group structure in 2n-dimensional axion-electrodynamics

evidence.text: What higher-group structure is encoded by axion electrodynamics in 2n dimensions, how does it appear in background gauge transformations and anomalies, and what additional operations arise in six dimensions?

sources.title: Goldstone Boson Decays and Chiral Anomalies

evidence.text: How are axion decays into two gauge bosons related to the anomalous divergence of a spontaneously broken global axial current in vector-like and chiral Abelian gauge theories, and what subtleties enter the chiral Ward-identity calculation?

sources.title: Generalized symmetry breaking scales and weak gravity conjectures

evidence.text: Can strong breaking of approximate generalized global symmetries within effective field theory motivate electric, magnetic and axion weak gravity conjectures, the distance conjecture, and a non-abelian analog?

sources.title: Emergence of Weak Coupling at Large Distance in Quantum Gravity

evidence.text: How do individual masses and EFT membership change when a Wilson-line axion moves through a large canonical distance? The example makes this question explicit through a charged tower with independent integer charge and KK labels.

sources.title: High-quality Axion Strings from Monopole Strings

evidence.text: Can extra-dimensional Wilson-line axions retain high quality while acquiring solitonic strings with tensions parametrically below quantum gravity, enabling post-inflationary axion dark matter?

sources.title: Axions, higher-groups, and emergent symmetry

evidence.text: How does higher-group mixing constrain the relative emergence scales of axion-string charge conservation, Wilson-line screening, axion shifts, magnetic symmetry, and flavor quotients in RG flows realizing axion gauge theories?

sources.title: Topological violation of global symmetries in quantum gravity

evidence.text: Can summing over spacetime topology violate global charges despite local current conservation, and generate axion shift-symmetry breaking without explicit breaking terms in the higher-dimensional UV Lagrangian?

sources.title: The Swampland Conjectures: A Bridge from Quantum Gravity to Particle Physics

evidence.text: Can an axionic Stückelberg mass for the Standard Model photon satisfy quantum-gravity consistency conditions? The review invokes a Weak Gravity Conjecture for strings magnetically charged under the mass-generating axions.

sources.title: Do We Live in the Swampland?

evidence.text: Can explicit quantum-gravity breaking of the axion shift symmetry eliminate the problematic maximum? The displayed higher-dimensional operator adds a harmonic while preserving periodicity of the combined potential.

sources.title: Testing the heterotic string with the axion-photon coupling

evidence.text: Can embedding hypercharge into both E8 factors evade the usual unified-theory bound on the axion-photon coupling-to-mass ratio, while preserving perturbative control and the observed gauge couplings?

sources.title: Revisiting wormhole-induced global symmetry breaking

evidence.text: Does introducing wormhole-induced symmetry-breaking α-parameters establish explicit global-symmetry breaking, or can averaging over them select the symmetric point? The paper examines how matter-sector vacuum structure controls this question and its implications for axion quality.

sources.title: Higher-group symmetries and weak gravity conjecture mixing

evidence.text: How are emergent higher-group symmetry constraints related to mixing between particle, instanton and string Weak Gravity Conjectures (WGCs), and how far does this relationship extend beyond axion electrodynamics?
